rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account via tool. It confirmed the order belonged to the authenticated user and had been delivered. The agent gathered precise exchange preferences, checked product availability with read-only tools, and correctly handled the keyboard fallback logic (clicky + RGB full-size unavailable; selected clicky, no backlight, full-size). It identified a Google Assistant-compatible thermostat variant and sought explicit confirmation listing exact changes. Only after the user confirmed did the agent execute the exchange with the correct item IDs and payment method. The reported refund amount ($16.63) matches the price differences derived from the tool data. The final status and next steps were accurately communicated. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed.
